description: This file is a shell script used to automate the process of cloning, configuring, building, and installing various CCSP components from a remote Git repository. It contains a main function 'execute_component' which handles different components such as ccsp-commonlib, ccsp-cr, ccsp-psm, etc., and sets up their build environment accordingly. The script also outputs a list of components and usage instructions.

methods.name: execute_component
methods.description: Main function that takes a username and component name, clones the corresponding repository, configures, builds, and installs the component based on specified parameters.
